chung.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
chung.Description:
1. Course Objectives:

This course provides the essential machine learning for Fintech students. The course focuses on understanding the foundations of machine learning, developing data handling skills, understanding practical implementation, and applying machine learning models to solve problems of moderate complexity. At the end of the course, students will gain ML knowledge and skills in using ML tools to analyze models that enable computers to make predictions, decisions, and insights based on data.

2. Course Content:

Key topics include: fundamentals of machine learning, basis mathematics for machine learning, basis machine learning algorithms, data handling and preprocessing, model training and evaluation, programming and tools

3. Activities and Teaching Methodology:

Lectures, quizzes, hands-on labs, individual assignments and group project to practice the ML tools and apply them to their skills in practical, job-oriented scenarios.
